thread:
Maya: Heads-up — while walking through the Python quickstart sample app I hit a weird error: the async client returns a generic RuntimeError instead of a structured HTTP/validation exception.
Sam: Repro'd locally. Getting a 400 from the server but the SDK just raises 'request failed' with no status or request_id. Very confusing for new users.
Maya: Minimal repro snippet I used:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
import os
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
await client.responses.create(input=None)  # intentionally invalid
```
Sam: Error log I see:
```
RuntimeError: request failed
  File ".../client.py", line 242, in _call
response body: {"error": "invalid_input", "request_id": "r-abc123"}
```
Julia: I think this is specific to the async code path. The sync client surfaces a RequestError with .status and .raw_body, but async seems to wrap+swallow.
Sam: I bisected to error_parsing.async_handler — we parse body but when re-raising we drop the parsed dict and only attach a short message.
Maya: This is onboarding friction: users can't correlate logs with server request_id. Also breaks typed exception handling.
Sam: Proposed fix: preserve response.raw_body and parsed_error on the raised exception, and add a typed HTTPValidationError subclass for 4xx with attributes: status, raw_body, parsed, request_id.
Julia: Also add stubs/typing in exception module and include py.typed so consumers can do "except redwood.errors.HTTPValidationError as e:" reliably.
Maya: Test plan: add a tiny e2e in the sampleapp CI that intentionally triggers a 422/400 and asserts exception.request_id == server header. Prevent regressions.
Sam: Opened issue: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/4521 with repro and stack trace. Draft PR in progress: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/789 (draft).
ci-bot: CI check started for PR 789 — job: test-async-errors (queued) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya: Can we bump this to P1 for DX? New users hit this in onboarding and it blocks basic debugging.
Julia: +1 from me. Will push review today and add type annotations.
Sam: I'll add a small changelog entry and a migration note for code that currently expects plain RuntimeError.
Maya: Thanks everyone — looping back once CI passes. :thumbsup:
